conventions.optical_frame: x right, y down, z forward; camera.R columns are optical axes in world; row-major 9
conventions.tag_frame: x right, y up, z out of face; tag.R columns are tag axes in world; corners (-h,-h),(h,-h),(h,h),(-h,h) at z=0
conventions.reason_order: TooOblique(back-face or angle) > Behind > OutOfFov(all four corners must be inside) > TooClose > TooSmall(sqrt shoelace area) > Occluded(any corner, last occlusion_eps removed)
conventions.error_scale: sqrt(trace) of position / rotation block of (J^T J)^-1 at 1 px corner noise, camera axes, at the true pose
